title: Safety of Cultured Allogeneic Adult Umbilical Cord or Placental Derived Mesenchymal Stem Cells for OA
official: Safety of Cultured Allogeneic Adult Umbilical Cord or Placental Derived Mesenchymal Stem Cells for the Treatment of Osteoarthritis
summary: This trial will study the safety and efficacy of cultured allogeneic adult umbilical cord or placental derived mesenchymal stem cells delivered intravenously and intraarticularly for the treatment of Osteoarthritis.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of Osteoarthritis
* Understanding and willingness to sign a written informed consent document

Exclusion Criteria:

* Active infection
* Active cancer
* Chronic multisystem organ failure
* Pregnancy
* Clinically significant Abnormalities on pre-treatment laboratory evaluation
* Medical condition that would (based on the opinion of the investigator) compromise patient's safety.
* Continued drug abuse
* Pre-menopausal women not using contraception
* Previous organ transplant
* Hypersensitivity to sulfur
sponsor: The Foundation for Orthopaedics and Regenerative Medicine
